camera.shot_scale_bias: extreme wide shots that dwarf the figure
camera.height: slightly low, looking up at the structure

lens.dof: deep focus with a soft atmospheric falloff into haze

sources: a single directional source behind haze
lighting.practicals: figures read as silhouettes against a brighter field

palette.grade: near-monochrome, one dominant hue per scene

rules: a lone figure against monumental architecture
a very high horizon or none at all
composition.movement_of_subject: the subject walks slowly into the depth of the frame

sound.ambience_bias: wind across open space, low infrasonic pressure, sparse distant impacts

music.instrumentation: A low brass drone with sub-bass swells
music.dynamics: building in volume over a long span before cutting to silence

must_include: haze, dust or fog separates the planes of the image
the human figure is small against the scale of the space

notes: Monumental scale, atmospheric haze, single-hue grading. Silence and space do the work.
